months.title: Check it. Lock it. Share it.
months.summary: Tools for checking and protecting the work: see how much of the plan is really in the code, freeze an agreed design, and share a clickable preview.

features.title: Gap Analysis
features.description: How much of the plan is really in the code? Every concept item gets a percentage, what is built, what is missing, and the code as proof.

features.title: From findings to tasks
features.description: Run the analysis for one phase or one task, turn what is missing into tasks, and compare before and now after a fix.

features.title: Lock Design
features.description: Freeze the concept, UI screens and requirements. Nobody and nothing changes them until you unlock: not a teammate, not an AI.

features.title: Imported projects get their real screens
features.description: Bring in existing code and the platform rebuilds the app's own screens in their original look, tied to the concept.

features.title: Interactive preview link
features.description: Share a full-screen, clickable preview of the screens only. Buttons and navigation work; nothing else is shown.

features.title: Company Agent Skills
features.description: Write your company's standing instructions once. Every agent follows them in every project.

features.title: More from your coding tool
features.description: Edit the concept item by item, run the whole task board and start a Gap Analysis from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex.

features.title: Export carries the whole design
features.description: A .thinkp file now includes styles, menus, images and documents, and can be imported as a new project from the start wizard.

months.title: Open to your tools
months.summary: Your AI coding tool can build and run an app in the think4ever cloud, the app covers nearly everything the web does, and reports read like prepared business documents.

features.title: Build and run from your coding tool
features.description: Claude Code, Cursor or Codex can write files, install packages, start the app, read its logs and publish it in the think4ever cloud.

features.title: Public API 1.0
features.description: The API now covers almost the whole workspace: code import, version control, documents, discussions, share links and more.

features.title: Analytical business reports
features.description: Eleven report types with charts, tables and conclusions in plain business language. Share by link or download as PDF.

features.title: The app becomes a full client
features.description: Version 1.0.1 covers nearly everything the web workspace does, in eight languages, with a Windows installer.

features.title: A proper welcome for new team members
features.description: A new member gets a welcome e-mail and chooses their own password at first sign-in. Details, roles and project access are set in one step.

features.title: Start from “What do you want to build?”
features.description: Choose your path on the first page. Your answer travels through sign-up, and the workspace opens on that step.

features.title: Sign in with an e-mailed code
features.description: No password needed: a six-digit code signs you in. Password rules are simpler too.

features.title: A complete hiring workflow
features.description: Hire several freelancers on one job, revise offers as numbered versions, and follow a shared activity timeline in the chat.

months.title: Your language. Ready for production.
months.summary: The whole product in eight languages, a go-live review for existing code, and a marketplace that knows your project.
months.marker: Last here three months ago? Everything above this line is new for you.

features.title: Eight languages
features.description: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Hindi, Dutch and Arabic with a right-to-left layout. One choice follows you everywhere.

features.title: The AI answers in your language
features.description: Sidekick, the build chat and the design chat reply in the language you chose. E-mails and notifications follow it too.

features.title: Production Hardening
features.description: A go-live review of your code: 39 checks in 9 areas, a score and an A–E grade, with evidence and a recommended fix per check.

features.title: Fix the findings in one click
features.description: Hand the findings to think4ever agents, or copy a ready fix request for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Download the review as PDF.

features.title: Imported code is understood better
features.description: The technology is detected from your code. React, Next.js, Remix, Supabase and Firebase projects are described correctly.

features.title: Hiring that knows your project
features.description: “Ask Think” drafts the job post from your project, and every proposal gets an AI fit score with strengths and concerns.

features.title: Exactly the access a freelancer needs
features.description: A contract grants a workspace login or a token for the freelancer's own coding tool, for chosen projects. It ends by itself.

features.title: Claude Opus 5.5, and a quick model switch
features.description: A new top model. If a model keeps failing, a pop-up moves just that kind of work to another one in two clicks.

also.text: Edit text in the design preview

months.title: A clear path from idea to running app
months.summary: A start wizard, a “What's next?” board, share links for your own customers, real PDF and Word files, and builds that pause instead of failing.

features.title: Start wizard
features.description: A new project asks one question: analyse existing code, or design from an idea. Then it takes you there.

features.title: “What's next?” board
features.description: Five steps from concept to a running app, each marked done, in progress or ready. Click a step to start it.

features.title: View & Share
features.description: Share a clean read-only view of the project by link, for people without an account. You choose the sections and an expiry.

features.title: Real PDF and Word files
features.description: Export requirement documents and the Functional Architecture as .pdf and .docx, and the requirements text in five formats.

features.title: Builds that pause instead of failing
features.description: Building an app from a design is much faster, and a step that fails pauses the plan so you can resume it.

features.title: Code Quality scan
features.description: Scan the project for bugs, vulnerabilities and code smells, with severity and fix time. Send findings to the agents to fix.

features.title: Application Architecture map
features.description: An interactive map of an existing codebase: its parts, the components inside them and how they relate.

features.title: Thumbnails, View Mode and a page chat
features.description: See a real picture of every screen, click through designs like a visitor, and ask questions about a page without changing it.

months.title: 173 themes, and an AI that asks first
months.summary: The visual side grew up, the AI became safer and steadier to work with, and large ideas could be built in phases.

features.title: 173 ready-made themes
features.description: Pick the look of your screens from a catalog of complete themes, each with a screenshot and a live demo.

features.title: Your own theme, or the style of your website
features.description: Describe a look and the AI builds the theme. Or enter a website address and reuse its colours, fonts and logo.

features.title: The AI asks before it changes anything
features.description: In both chats the AI shows what it plans to change and waits for “Confirm & Apply” or “Reject”.

features.title: Phases (Roadmap)
features.description: Split a concept into named phases, filter the canvas by phase and build one phase at a time.

features.title: Build with us or with your own tool
features.description: Press Build and choose: think4ever agents, or Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and six other tools that read your design directly.

features.title: Project Memory
features.description: Decisions, constraints and preferences are remembered per project and used in later sessions. You can view and edit them.

features.title: Choose the model per type of work
features.description: Pick a model separately for concept, UI design, diagrams, chat, building and documents. GLM-5.2 and Kimi K3 joined the list.

features.title: Freelance marketplace
features.description: Post jobs, send proposals, agree contracts and chat live. The freelancer gets access to the agreed project while the contract runs.

also.text: Download the project, export the database
A receipt of what the AI changed

months.title: Sidekick takes the wheel
months.summary: The workspace changed shape, the assistant started doing the work instead of describing it, and the platform opened up to other tools.
months.marker: Last here six months ago? Everything above this line is new for you.

features.title: Sidekick does the clicking
features.description: The assistant answers live and acts: it changes the concept, creates tasks, opens the right page and runs menu actions for you.

features.title: Build, run and import from the chat
features.description: Ask Sidekick to create or change UI screens, start or stop your app, show its logs, or import code from GitHub.

features.title: Your plan inside Claude Code, Cursor and Codex
features.description: AI coding tools connect over MCP and work from the same concept, designs and tasks. Setup guides for nine tools.

features.title: Public API
features.description: A documented API with access tokens you create, limit and revoke yourself, and a console to try calls.

features.title: Eleven concept layers
features.description: Four new layers: API Endpoints, State & Lifecycle, Events & Jobs, Environment & Config. The plan now covers the whole product.

features.title: think4ever app for Windows and Android
features.description: Projects, the concept canvas, requirements, UI previews, Sidekick and a developer workspace in a native app.

features.title: New layout, dark theme
features.description: Menus on top, Sidekick docked on the left on every page, and a dark theme with a light/dark switch.

features.title: Ten connectors
features.description: Jira, Confluence, Figma, GitHub, Slack, Notion, Linear, Sentry, Google Drive and OneDrive. Attach items to the chat or let the AI search them.

also.text: New projects start as a conversation
The whole project in one file

months.title: From idea to running code in one place
months.summary: The month the product became one connected tool: plan the project, switch to code, let the agents build it step by step, run it and share a public link.

features.title: Developer Mode joins the workspace
features.description: One sign-in, two views of the same project. Switch from design to code: AI coding chat, file editor, terminal, database and a browser for your running app.

features.title: Goals with a plan you approve
features.description: Describe what you want. The agents draft a step-by-step plan; you review it, untick steps, and run. Skip, pause or cancel at any time.

features.title: Build from your design
features.description: “From Design” compares the code with your concept and UI designs and plans the work to close the gap.

features.title: Run your app and share a public link
features.description: The app runs inside the workspace. One switch gives it a public address that anyone can open.

features.title: Solution Designs Library
features.description: 299 ready-made starting points in 10 industries. Search, preview and apply one with a click: screens, flows, data, roles and rules included.

features.title: VS Code extension
features.description: Edit project files in VS Code, keep a local folder in two-way sync, talk to the agents and send terminal errors back to them.

features.title: Start with “What do you want to build?”
features.description: Describe the idea in your own words, attach files, or import existing code from GitHub, a ZIP or your repository.

features.title: Company Users with roles
features.description: Add team members, give them roles and decide per project who has access. Each member sees only what their role allows.

also.text: Limit what an agent may change

months.title: Run the project where you plan it
months.summary: The workspace grew from “plan and build” into a place where a team can also run the project: issues, a knowledge base, feedback forms and a Jira connection.

features.title: Issue tracker
features.description: Report and follow bugs, features and tasks inside the project: list, board and summary views, filters, comments and file attachments.

features.title: Knowledge base
features.description: A wiki for each project with a block editor, auto-save, version history, templates, tags and Markdown export.

features.title: Feedback forms by public link
features.description: Build a survey, poll or feedback form and share it by link. People answer without an account; results can be exported to CSV.

features.title: Start a concept from your documents
features.description: Attach requirements, specs or notes. The AI writes the requirements from them or builds the whole concept.

features.title: More AI models, plus Grok
features.description: Newer Claude, GPT, Gemini and DeepSeek models, and Grok as a new provider. Long answers are no longer cut short.

features.title: Jira connection
features.description: Connect a Jira project and bring its issues into the platform's issue tracker, with status and priority matched.

features.title: Your own key works everywhere
features.description: Documents and presentations work with any provider's key, and several agents can work on one key at the same time.

features.title: Comments and mentions in one place
features.description: All comment threads, your @mentions and every active share link are collected on one page.

months.title: Edit anything, undo anything
months.summary: Requirements that keep the plan in step, a history you can step back through, design tools for every element, and the first account portal.

features.title: Requirements that update the plan
features.description: Edit the requirements and the AI proposes the matching concept changes, each with a reason. Tick the ones you want and apply.

features.title: Change History with one-click revert
features.description: Every AI change to the concept is listed with time and description. One click takes the concept back to before that change.

features.title: Edit any element in the design preview
features.description: Right-click an element to change its text size, colours and spacing directly, or choose “Ask AI to Change” for just that element.

features.title: 20 page layouts with live preview
features.description: Choose the page structure before building: sidebar, dashboard, hero, grid, split screen and more, previewed on desktop, tablet and phone.

features.title: Your own images in the design
features.description: Upload a logo, pictures or media with an instruction such as “use this as the main logo” and the AI places them.

features.title: Code editor and ZIP upload
features.description: Open any source file in a built-in editor, and bring an existing codebase in as a ZIP of up to 500 MB.

features.title: The account portal
features.description: Sign up once and enter your workspace with one click, already signed in. Your profile, settings and support live there too.

features.title: Search across the whole concept
features.description: One search box finds screens, flows, data objects, roles, integrations and rules, and jumps to the result.

also.text: A written summary for every screen

months.title: One workspace, six layers
months.summary: The concept grew from screens only into a full picture of the product, and everything moved into one project workspace.

features.title: A concept with six layers
features.description: Next to screens: Business Flows, Data Objects, Roles & Permissions, Integrations and Business Rules. Sidekick builds and edits all six.

features.title: The new Project Workspace
features.description: One menu for everything in a project: concept layers, UI designs, diagrams, documents, tasks, database, source code and version control.

features.title: Bring your existing code
features.description: Point the platform at a codebase and it writes the concept from the code, with a live progress window.

features.title: See the concept through one role
features.description: Pick a role and the screens it can reach are highlighted. Each screen lists who has access.

features.title: Designs and diagrams build in the background
features.description: UI designs and architecture diagrams are built while you keep working, and appear in their own pages when ready.

features.title: Users, groups and permissions
features.description: Add team users, put them in ready-made groups and decide what each group may do. The interface hides what a user may not use.

features.title: Use your own AI keys
features.description: Add your own provider keys under My API Keys and run all AI work on them.

features.title: Better build planning and task control
features.description: Bigger builds are planned in stages, Cancel really stops a task, and the task list has filters, cancel-all and live status.

also.text: Quick start on an empty concept

months.title: You choose the technology and the look
months.summary: Two decisions the AI used to make alone became yours: what the product is built with, and how it looks.

features.title: Technology Stack
features.description: Choose your backend, database and front end from long lists. Every agent and every document then follows your choice.

features.title: Theme gallery
features.description: Pick one of 34 ready-made colour themes for your UI design and preview it on sample elements first. (Today the catalog holds 173.)

features.title: Test Case Agent
features.description: Test cases written from your code: numbered steps, the expected result of each step, priorities and tags, grouped by area.

features.title: More dependable Git commits
features.description: Committing now works on a brand-new folder, picks the right branch and pulls the latest changes first.

also.text: Developer Agent can start from nothing

months.title: Your repository, your documents
months.summary: Two things teams ask for early: a connection to their own code repository, and finished documents written from the concept.
months.marker: Last here a year ago? Everything above this line is new for you.

features.title: Version Control
features.description: Connect a project to GitHub, GitLab, plain Git or SVN. Commit, update and read the full log of every operation.

features.title: The Developer Agent commits its own work
features.description: After a successful coding task the agent commits the changes to your repository, with its own explanation as the message.

features.title: Documents written from your concept
features.description: Concept Summary, Functional Specification, Technical Specification and Database Design Document, each with a cover page and table of contents.

features.title: Export as SVG and PNG
features.description: Download the concept as a clean vector drawing or a picture, and any flow diagram as an image.

months.title: The AI asks before it builds
months.summary: The platform now helps you work out what you actually want before anything is drawn.

features.title: Analyze Requirements
features.description: Describe a rough idea. The AI asks clarifying questions, with a “Let AI decide” option, and turns your answers into written requirements and a concept.

features.title: Requirements stay with the concept
features.description: Every concept carries a written description of what the system should do. Read it, edit it and save it at any time.

features.title: Card and Chart elements
features.description: Screens in a concept can now contain cards and charts, and the AI uses them when they fit.

features.title: Voice Assistant lets you finish your sentence
features.description: A short pause no longer cuts you off: the assistant waits a moment longer before it answers.

months.title: From concept to clickable screens
months.summary: The month the platform learned to design. One button turns a concept into real pages you can click through and change by describing what you want.

features.title: Build UI Design
features.description: One button turns your concept into a full set of real pages with a shared style and working navigation between them.

features.title: Click through your design like an app
features.description: Open the designed pages in a browser tab, jump to any page from a Pages menu, and follow the links between screens.

features.title: Change a page by describing it
features.description: In the Modify Page chat you say what should change. The AI sees the page as you see it and changes only what you asked for.

features.title: Undo and version history for every page
features.description: Every change to a page is kept. Go back to any earlier version with one click; nothing is lost.

features.title: Architecture diagrams from one concept
features.description: One button draws a full set of diagrams from your concept: user flow, data flow, database schema, sequence, deployment, security and more.

features.title: Security Agent
features.description: A security review of your code: issues by severity with the affected files and references to CWE and OWASP. Download it as a Word report.

also.text: Flow-diagram editor with its own Sidekick
Try a screen as a clickable mock-up
Export the concept as a picture

months.title: Talk your idea into a plan
months.summary: Where this story starts: a workspace with projects, a visual concept canvas, an AI chat and a team of AI agents. In September the platform learned to listen, and to build from what it heard.

features.title: Talk your idea into a concept
features.description: The Voice Assistant asks what you want to build, reads back a summary and draws the concept for you.

features.title: One-click Build
features.description: A Build button hands your concept to the AI agents and takes you to the task list when the work is done.

features.title: Analytical Agent
features.description: Ask a question about your data and get a report with tables, charts and conclusions, built only from your real data.

features.title: A project that is ready from minute one
features.description: Every new project gets its own folder and its own database automatically. Nothing to set up by hand.

QA Agent explains why an app would not start
